_comment: Curated release-form (IR/XR/DEP) vocabulary + brand map — Specs/stereoisomer-and-release-form-axes.md Stage B. IDENTITY/LABEL ONLY: the data-reality check (2026-07-15) confirmed NO source carries a distinct extended-release dose or duration row — every durations/dose_ranges row for Methylphenidate/Amphetamine is the base form, and no curated file keys a duration by release. IR vs XR differ only in duration, and that duration data does not exist for us. So release form is deliberately NOT a dose/duration axis (no release_form column on dose_ranges/durations, no app picker): it is a pure identity + label facet that lets a logged brand string ('Concerta') recover the form it named. Consumed by sqlite.py annotate_alias_facets() -> aliases.release_form and build_substance_forms() -> the PSID <release> field. If per-release durations are ever authored, THAT is the point to promote this to a real axis with a picker.
_fields: codes.<CODE>: displayName = the prose label; titleSuffix = what a form title appends ('Methylphenidate XR', 'Naltrexone Depot' — the bare code reads well for the recognized abbreviations but not for DEP); rank = default-selection order mirroring _SALT_METADATA (0 = pre-select), forward-looking until anything consumes it; tokens = bare abbreviations, matched only as a TRAILING standalone token; phrases = matched anywhere on a word boundary. CODE must be radix-36 to ride the PSID <release> field, and must not be '0' (the unspecified sentinel).

IR._comment: Only tagged where a brand EXPLICITLY says IR to contrast with an XR sibling ('Adderall IR', 'MAS-IR'). A bare base brand ('Adderall', 'Ritalin') is left untagged — it is the unspecified/standard form, i.e. the PSID `0` sentinel — so we never assert a form the name didn't claim.

XR._comment: Umbrella for every prolonged-release marketing variant (XR/ER/SR/CR/LA/XL). These are deliberately NOT split into separate codes: their kinetic differences are real but we hold no duration data to back them, so a finer code would assert a distinction we cannot substantiate. The literal brand ('Ritalin LA') survives as the alias, so nothing is lost.

DEP._comment: Long-acting injectables (weeks-to-months). Genuinely distinct from oral XR rather than a marketing variant of it, which is why it earns its own code. Curated-only — no token fires for it.

_excluded_comment: Transdermal patches (Daytrana, Butrans, Duragesic, Xelstrym) are prolonged-delivery but are NOT tagged: transdermal is the ROUTE axis, and tagging them here would conflate two orthogonal axes. Prodrugs (Vyvanse, Azstarys/serdexmethylphenidate) are not release forms either — their duration comes from metabolic conversion, not a formulation. Combos (Suboxone, Contrave) and route-specific forms (Belbuca, buccal) likewise stay out. Ambiguous bare brands that ship in both IR and ER (Nucynta, Palexia, bare 'Metadate') are left untagged rather than guessed.
